#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <regex>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin.ignore(); // To consume the newline after the integer input
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);

    std::regex regex("\\([\\w_]*\\)");
    std::sregex_token_iterator iter(line.begin(), line.end(), regex, -1);
    std::sregex_token_iterator end;

    int maxWordLength = 0;
    for (; iter != end; ++iter) {
        std::string segment = *iter;
        // Split segment by '_'
        size_t start = 0;
        size_t end_pos;
        int currentMax = 0;
        while ((end_pos = segment.find('_', start)) != std::string::npos) {
            std::string word = segment.substr(start, end_pos - start);
            if (!word.empty()) {
                currentMax = std::max(currentMax, (int)word.length());
            }
            start = end_pos + 1;
        }
        // Last word after last underscore
        std::string lastWord = segment.substr(start);
        if (!lastWord.empty()) {
            currentMax = std::max(currentMax, (int)lastWord.length());
        }
        if (currentMax > maxWordLength) {
            maxWordLength = currentMax;
        }
    }

    // Find all matches of the pattern
    std::regex pattern("\\([\\w_]*\\)");
    auto matches_begin = std::sregex_iterator(line.begin(), line.end(), pattern);
    auto matches_end = std::sregex_iterator();

    long long totalInsideWords = 0;
    for (auto it = matches_begin; it != matches_end; ++it) {
        std::string match_str = it->str();
        // Remove parentheses
        std::string inside = match_str.substr(1, match_str.length() - 2);
        // Split inside by '_'
        size_t start = 0;
        size_t end_pos;
        while ((end_pos = inside.find('_', start)) != std::string::npos) {
            std::string s = inside.substr(start, end_pos - start);
            if (!s.empty()) {
                totalInsideWords++;
            }
            start = end_pos + 1;
        }
        // Last word after last underscore
        std::string lastWord = inside.substr(start);
        if (!lastWord.empty()) {
            totalInsideWords++;
        }
    }

    std::cout << maxWordLength << " " << totalInsideWords << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
